CustomField.description: This is to format the date field in the Email Template
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK( QTB_End_Date__c), '', TEXT( DAY(QTB_End_Date__c) ) + "-" + CASE( MONTH(QTB_End_Date__c), 1,"JAN", 2,"FEB", 3,"MAR", 4,"APR", 5,"MAY", 6,"JUN", 7,"JUL", 8,"AUG", 9,"SEP", 10,"OCT", 11,"NOV", 12,"DEC", "Month") + "-" + TEXT( YEAR(QTB_End_Date__c) ))
CustomField.label: End Date Merge field
